project.name: Traveltestproject
project.description: The Travel Booking Website Automation Testing project focuses on automating the testing of a travel booking application using Selenium WebDriver with Java. The main objective is to verify the functionality of different modules, such as user login, flight search, hotel booking, destination selection, date selection, passenger details, and booking confirmation. Automation scripts are developed to validate application functionality, identify defects, and ensure a smooth user experience. Test cases are executed using Selenium WebDriver, Java, TestNG, and Page Object Model (POM) to improve test reusability and maintainability.
